ellie: Heads-up  AE flagged Pacifica Health wants a 3-week POC with a customer-finetuned model `pacifica-13b-ft-lite`. Requirements: Private deploy in eu-west-1, customer KMS, embeddings + chat, and P95 <160ms for short queries at ~35 rps. They also want deterministic evals and per-request metadata logs. Any blockers?

rafa: Quick clarifying q  artifact format and tokenizer? Any adapters?

ellie: They uploaded `pacifica-13b-ft-lite.gguf` plus `tokenizer.json` and a tiny LoRA adapter `pacifica_adapter.pt`. Tokenizer is custom BPE and their eos token is non-standard. They want embeddings to match cosine-normalized vectors.

sam: Runtime notes: gguf + LoRA supported but we should run an adapter-merge smoke test. Custom eos means we must validate special token mapping; a shim is possible but adds ~5-12ms. Deterministic = temperature=0, top_p=1.

ops-bot: [artifact-scan] pacifica-13b-ft-lite.gguf scanned: tokenizer.json present, vocab size 49,800; adapter detected (PyTorch state_dict). No license blocks. Suggest tokenizer compatibility check and adapter merge test.

security-bot: [sec-scan] Security questionnaire parsed  outstanding: KMS ARN missing, retention TTL for metadata logs unspecified, and EU-only data-residency requirement. Recommend customer supply Key ARN with policy granting RedwoodDeployRole kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey.

rafa: Perf: 13B at 35 rps P95<160ms is aggressive. Options: (1) Dedicated warm pool pinned to the model with 2 warm replicas + KV caching, (2) int8 quant + more replicas, or (3) hybrid: embeddings on a 6-7B embedder and gen on 13B. If they accept int8 we can reduce GPU footprint and cost.

ellie: Customer asked about automatic fallback to a distilled 7B when capacity is constrained. Can we provide that with a clear note about output differences?

sam: Yes  we can configure a fallback policy to `pacifica-7b-distill`. We'll run a regression eval on their prompt set to quantify drift and include thresholds in SOW. Also will check embedding dimensionality and cosine alignment.

rafa: Minimal POC deploy config to propose:
```
model: pacifica-13b-ft-lite
format: gguf
adapter: pacifica_adapter.pt (merged at deploy)
precision: int8
deploy_mode: private
region: eu-west-1
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 5
batching: { max_tokens: 1024, dynamic_window_ms: 8 }
audit_mode: metadata-only (raw-inputs require SOW)
fallback_policy: route_to_pacifica_7b_on_capacity
```

ops-bot: [ticket] Created SW-5123 "Pacifica Health POC  pacifica-13b-ft-lite onboarding" assigned to rafa,sam,ellie. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/SW-5123

ellie: Action items: Rafa -> infra sizing + pricing delta (fp16 vs int8) and warmup plan. Sam -> tokenizer compatibility + adapter merge smoke test + small regression eval. I'll draft SOW and ask AE to collect KMS ARN and log retention TTL.

sam: Running tokenizer check and adapter merge now; will post quick mismatch + regression excerpt in the Jira ticket.

rafa: I'll size infra and respond with a POC quote and recommended GPU families within 24h. If customer requests HSM escalate to security.

ellie: Thanks team  ping here if any blocker. :thumbsup:
